p-3-1: This project simulates an e-commerce website centered around old stuff and replicas.
p-3-2: It uses NextJS and Prisma for fullstack development.
p-4: This is my first "real" project, I built it to learn hands on the essentials of software development, eg: UI/UX, interacting with an  API/backend, third-party services, etc. Also I thought it would be the perfect project considering I like music and Spotify has great documentation for devs
li-1: • It has email + password authentication, aswell as authentication provided via GitHub Oauth
li-2: • Users have an inventory with all the items that they bought/have
li-3: • Users can put up new items for sale or put up for sale directly from their stock
li-4: • There are transactions and activity pages where users can see their transactions(and search through them)  and their activities(Item put up for sale and their stock)
li-5: • It uses atomic transactions(OOoOooOOOoOoo atomic transactions) for things like sales and purchases
